rule_text.name: 702.207a
rule_text.rule: Revive is an activated ability that functions while the card with revive is in a graveyard. “Revive (cost)” means “(cost), Exile this card from your graveyard: Create a token that’s a copy of this card, except it has no mana cost. Activate this ability only any time you could cast a sorcery.”

rule_text.name: 702.207b
rule_text.rule: Revive will create a token that's a copy of the card as it was in the graveyard, rather than it is in exile.
